stage2_evidence.claim: type 33 reader 的 object_off=68 与 schema 中仅属于 club 的 CMWE（Maximum Wage Allowed）成员对齐；reader 邻接链 chain_0145 的指令读取 [rbx+0x44]，CMWE 跨实体 df=1。

details.independence: type 33 自己的 reader 序列含 object_off=68，且有独立静态指令/唯一 schema 码直接命名 club 字段；不借用 type 3 的行数或其他类型的归属判断。

table_type 33 is independently decoded from its jump-table rel32 entry to handler_off 0xf4941b; BFS depth 2 reaches a vtable assignment at 0x3bdb232, whose preceding COL/TD chain names STARTING_CLUB_DEBT. The anchor uses the constructor/class identity, not record-count similarity or a schema-code vote.

row_closure.basis: full payload size/count/stride closure; stride is arithmetic census evidence, not a schema serializer proof

profile_method.limits: value domains are diagnostics; they do not independently identify fields
